title: feat: Payments microservice scaffold
author: arjun.mehta
description:
Initial scaffold for the Payments microservice. Sets up:
- Service directory structure
- Express app with payments-specific middleware
- Database connection to the payments PostgreSQL schema
- Stub endpoints for /payments/charge, /payments/refund, /webhooks/stripe
- Docker configuration for isolated VPC deployment (NEX-218)
- Environment configuration for Stripe API keys (from AWS Secrets Manager, NEX-207)

Architecture decisions from architecture_review_01 are reflected here: dedicated schema, audit log table stub (NEX-219), network isolation assumptions.

Related: NEX-204, architecture_review_01, email_01

review_comments.author: riya.desai
review_comments.comment: Clean scaffold. The payments schema isolation looks good. One suggestion: add a health check endpoint for k8s liveness probes.

review_comments.author: arjun.mehta
review_comments.comment: Good call — added /health endpoint in latest commit.
